opsproc.title: Flight Lock Actuator (Inoperative in Unlocked Position)

procitem.title: PROCEDURE TO BE DEVELOPED IN THE OPERATOR'S MEL

inform.para: Alternate procedures must be established and used to designate a cabin attendant or other suitability trained person employed by the operator in excess of the minimum required number of cabin attendants to remain seated in the passenger seat nearest the affected exit when the cabin differential pressure is below 4.
